body_text:
About DarGlobal PLC
Location: Dubai, London, Riyadh, Muscat, Marbella
About DarGlobal PLC: DarGlobal is the premier international luxury real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE: DAR). Born as the international arm of Dar Al Arkan, Saudi Arabia's leading real estate developer with over 30 years of track record, DarGlobal focuses on second homes and luxury residential investments in prime global cities. Geographic Footprint: DarGlobal operates across six prime international markets: 1. United Arab Emirates: Dubai (Business Bay, Downtown Dubai, Jumeirah Golf Estates, Sheikh Zayed Road) and Ras Al Khaimah (Al Marjan Island). 2. Sultanate of Oman: Muscat (AIDA clifftop community overlooking the Sea of Oman). 3. Kingdom of Saudi Arabia: Jeddah (Corniche) and Riyadh. 4. State of Qatar: Simaisma / Rayana luxury waterfront developments. 5. Spain: Costa del Sol (Marbella, Benahavis, Finca Cortesin / Casares). 6. United Kingdom: Prime Central London (Kensington, Knightsbridge, Mayfair). Luxury Co-Branded Partnerships: DarGlobal pioneered branded residences across the Middle East and Europe, partnering with iconic fashion, automotive, and hospitality brands: - Automotive: Pagani Automobili (DaVinci Tower), Aston Martin (The Astera), Automobili Lamborghini (Tierra Viva). - Haute Couture & Fashion: Elie Saab (Les Vagues), Missoni (Urban Oasis, Marea), Fendi Casa (Rayana Mansions). - Hospitality: The Trump Organization (Trump Tower Dubai, Trump Tower Jeddah, Trump International Golf Club & Hotel AIDA, Trump Mansions Qatar), Marriott International (W Residences Dubai, Marriott Residences AIDA). Investment Advantages: DarGlobal properties offer exceptional rental yields, capital growth, and eligibility for long-term residency visas, including the UAE 10-Year Golden Visa, Spain Golden Visa, and Oman Investor Visa.

body_text:
Frequently Asked Questions
Location: Dubai, London, Riyadh, Muscat, Marbella
Frequently Asked Questions about DarGlobal: 1. Who is DarGlobal? DarGlobal PLC is the international real estate development arm of Dar Al Arkan, listed on the London Stock Exchange under ticker LSE: DAR. It specializes in luxury second homes and branded residences across the UAE, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and the UK. 2. What luxury brands does DarGlobal partner with? DarGlobal has co-developed landmark residences with Pagani Automobili, Aston Martin, Automobili Lamborghini, Elie Saab, Missoni, FENDI Casa, Marriott International (W Hotels), and The Trump Organization. 3. In which countries does DarGlobal have projects? DarGlobal develops properties in: - United Arab Emirates: Dubai (Business Bay, Downtown, Jumeirah Golf Estates, Sheikh Zayed Road) and Ras Al Khaimah (Al Marjan Island). - Oman: Muscat (AIDA clifftop community). - Saudi Arabia: Jeddah and Riyadh. - Qatar: Simaisma (Rayana). - Spain: Costa del Sol (Marbella, Benahavis, Casares / Finca Cortesin). - United Kingdom: Prime Central London (Kensington, Mayfair). 4. What payment plans are available? Most off-plan developments offer milestone payment plans such as 60/40, 70/30, or 30/70, with down payments typically starting at 10% to 20% and the balance paid during construction or upon handover. 5. Does DarGlobal accept cryptocurrency or international currencies? Yes, DarGlobal accepts major international currencies (AED, USD, GBP, EUR, SAR, OMR, QAR) as well as approved cryptocurrency payments for select projects through regulated partners. 6. Can I get a residency visa by buying DarGlobal property? Yes! - UAE: Purchases over AED 2,000,000 qualify for the UAE 10-Year Golden Visa. - Spain: Purchases over EUR 500,000 qualify for the Spanish Golden Visa. - Oman: Properties in Integrated Tourism Complexes (ITC) like AIDA qualify foreign buyers and their families for the Oman Investor Residency Visa.
